facts.claim: Name is Paritala Sreeram (also spelled Sriram in the press); Telugu: పరిటాల శ్రీరామ్.
Son of the late Paritala Ravindra and Paritala Sunitha; described by himself as the elder son.
Paritala Ravindra was a Telugu Desam Party leader who was assassinated on 24 January 2005.
Paritala Sunitha is a former minister (2014-2019, Chandrababu Naidu cabinet) and MLA for Raptadu (2009, 2014, 2024).
Education: graduate, with a diploma in international business from MDIS (graduated August 2009).
Declared profession in the 2019 affidavit: business and agriculture.
2019: contested Raptadu as the TDP candidate after his mother stepped aside; finished second with 85,626 votes; Thopudurthi Prakash Reddy (YSRCP) won with 111,201; margin 25,575.
facts.note: Vote counts agree across two aggregators. Percentages differ (42.35% vs 42.73%) so they are not published. Official ECI Form 20 not directly opened.

facts.claim: 2024: the Dharmavaram seat was allotted to the BJP under the alliance; BJP's Satya Kumar Yadav won it. Sreeram did not contest in 2024.
After the 2024 allotment he said he would keep working with TDP cadres in Dharmavaram (paraphrased; no direct quote used).
Current designation: Telugu Desam Party in-charge for Dharmavaram.
Chairman, Paritala Ravindra Memorial Trust.
facts.note: Taken from his own Instagram bio only. No independent source or trust programme coverage found. Labelled 'per official Instagram profile' on the site.

facts.claim: 23 October 2026: filed nomination for the Nallacheruvu ZPTC seat (Kadiri constituency, Sri Sathya Sai district) at the Zilla Parishad office in Kothacheruvu, with Kadiri MLA Kandikunta Venkata Prasad and TDP district president M.S. Raju.
Press reports describe him as the TDP's expected candidate for Sri Sathya Sai Zilla Parishad chairperson if he wins the ZPTC seat.
facts.note: Reported as expectation, not as an official party announcement.

facts.claim: Revised local-body schedule: MPTC/ZPTC polling on 5 November 2026, counting on 7 November 2026 (moved from 3 November).
facts.note: Official SEC confirmation pending (S16). Earlier reports gave 1/3 Nov for polling - superseded.
